rule: On the tune split (key_tune.json, seed 2019, 48 scenarios per level, NONE arm only, 2 samples, temperature 0.7), choose the lowest generator level whose no-skill recall lies in [0.5, 0.7]. The held-out set is generated at that level from a different seed (3019).

attempts.note: explicit numeric rules and formulas in the task text, 250-400 word answers; no-skill recall 1.000 at every level (a checklist any model executes): instrument at ceiling, discarded
category definitions without thresholds or formulas, 400 words, per-arm user totals shown at every level; no-skill recall 0.875, 0.833, 0.780, 0.852: still too high, discarded
same definitions, 150-word answers; level 2 hides per-arm user totals (users must be summed from the device table); level 3 also gives a planned end date instead of a duration. Final.
